anchors.paper_title: MNE-BIDS: Organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format and facilitating their analysis
anchors.paper_venue: The Journal of Open Source Software
anchors.reason: The paper describes MNE-BIDS, a tool and specification for organizing electrophysiological data into the BIDS format, which is a general technical method, not a paper introducing the ToonFaces dataset.

anchors.paper_title: EEG-BIDS, an extension to the brain imaging data structure for electroencephalography
anchors.reason: The paper introduces EEG-BIDS, an extension to the BIDS standard for EEG data, which is a technical specification/tool, not a paper describing the specific ToonFaces dataset.

metadata.methods_description: EEG signals were recorded while participants viewed images of stylized faces and standard faces. Event-related potentials (ERPs) were analyzed, with particular focus on the N170 component as a neural correlate of facial encoding and emotion processing.
